headline: Crypto slid again early on Monday, with ether down about 6% in a day and bitcoin near $74,000, as an Nvidia-led tech sell-off weighed on the market.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko at about 11:56 UTC Mon 9 Nov (18:56 Bangkok). CoinMarketCap at the same time showed BTC $74,139 (-2.1%), ETH $2,102 (-5.9%), SOL $86.22 (-3.7%). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 28 (Fear), up from 25 (Extreme Fear) the day before. CoinMarketCap's own index showed 27 (Fear).

stories.title: Crypto slides again before the US open as Nvidia sinks; ether hit hardest
stories.summary: After bouncing above $75,000 overnight, bitcoin slipped back to about $74,400 by 11:42 UTC, per CoinDesk, while ether fell 5.9% to about $2,100 and XRP fell 7.3%. Nvidia shares fell 4.5% before the US open after it opened an internal investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort, per Reuters. CoinDesk says only five of the top 100 cryptocurrencies were up 1% or more over 24 hours.
points: About $1.1B of leveraged positions were liquidated in 24 hours, about $501M of it in ether and mostly bets on higher prices, per CoinDesk; Cointelegraph counts $1.12B through 09:00 UTC Monday.
Sources differ on the weekend low: about $73,761 per CoinDesk, about $73,500 (lowest since 21 Aug) per Cointelegraph.
Bitcoin's one-week implied volatility rose to about 43% from about 33%, a sign traders are paying up for protection, per CoinDesk.
US stock futures were higher (S&P 500 E-minis +0.40%) even as Nvidia fell, per Reuters at 5:10am ET.
CoinDesk names the 200-day average near $73,150 as the level traders watch.

stories.title: Bitcoin dips below Strategy's average cost as US bitcoin ETFs turn negative for 2026
stories.summary: Strategy (MSTR), the biggest corporate bitcoin holder, owns 849,327 BTC bought at an average of $75,451, per its 2 Nov SEC filing. With bitcoin trading around $74,000 on Monday, that stake is now below its cost, per CryptoTicker. Meanwhile US spot bitcoin ETFs had their worst week since late June, losing about $1.28B and turning 2026 flows negative.
points: Strategy's total cost is $64.08B; last week it bought 811 BTC for $65.5M at about $80,846 each, per the filing.
As of Monday morning no new Strategy purchase filing had appeared at the SEC, per CryptoTicker.
ETF flows for 2026 are now about -$914M; Friday alone was -$411.9M, with BlackRock's IBIT -$403M, per The Block.
US spot ether ETFs lost about $365M last week, per crypto.news citing Farside.
MSCI publishes its index review on Wed 11 Nov; Strategy is among the firms that could be removed, per TechTimes.

stories.title: Binance hack fallout: new CFO, withdrawals reopening, reserves still lower
stories.summary: Binance's new CFO Justin Yek, formerly at Airwallex, replaces Kaiser Ng; Binance says the change was planned six months ago and is unrelated to the hack, per Fortune. On Sunday Binance re-enabled HYPE and APT withdrawals. CryptoQuant data shows its reserves have fallen sharply since the 29 Oct hack, though daily outflows have slowed.
points: Fortune puts the theft at about $6.3B and says Tether and Circle froze about $2.5B; Binance says users will not bear losses.
Since the hack Binance's BTC reserves are down about 56,000 BTC (7.7%) and ETH reserves about 11.5%, per CryptoQuant via Bitcoin.com News.
ETH-based stablecoins on Binance fell about $9B (22%) to about $32B, per the same data.
crypto.news puts net customer withdrawals since the restart at $4.72B.

briefs.title: US withdraws a proposed travel-rule change for fund transfers
briefs.summary: FinCEN and the Federal Reserve withdrew a proposed rule on record-keeping and the 'travel rule' for funds transfers, including crypto transfers, per FinCEN.

briefs.title: MEXC to be cut off from US banks
briefs.summary: FinCEN says MEXC facilitated at least $16B in illicit transactions and its order stops US financial institutions from processing transfers involving the exchange.

briefs.title: Payments tokens lead altcoin losses
briefs.summary: XRP fell 7.3% to about $1.08 and Binance's Nvidia perpetual futures volume jumped more than 200% to over $500M as traders bet on Nvidia around the clock, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: SpaceX plans a $24B Texas supercomputer
briefs.summary: The project is worth about 17 times SpaceX's 18,712 BTC (about $1.39B), per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: ACryptoS vaults drained
briefs.summary: About $665,000 was taken from 77 vaults across 5 chains through a missing input check; the protocol is being wound down, per crypto.news citing SlowMist.

briefs.title: Europe's bank regulator takes over USDC reserve supervision
briefs.summary: The European Banking Authority takes over supervision of USDC reserves on 12 Nov, and Gemini reports earnings the same day, per CoinDesk's week ahead.

briefs.title: Democrats plan a broader crypto market-structure bill
briefs.summary: After sweeping the midterms, House Democrats reportedly plan a broader crypto bill that would give the SEC more power and limit the CFTC, per Decrypt.
